name: Dynamic Design Composition Engine

team12.name: Static Deterministic Constraint Layout Planning
team12.provides: LayoutPlanInput — a fully solved layout plan with strategy, flow, heroWeight, sectionCount, hasSidebar, emphasis
team12.team13_consumes: LayoutPlanInput verbatim — Team 13 does NOT re-solve layout constraints
team12.rule: Team 13 MUST NOT contain a second layout solver. Any layout strategy/flow value is accepted as-is from Team 12.

team13.name: Composition Orchestration
team13.responsibility: Combines blueprint + layoutPlan + components + pattern + palette + typography + decoration + material + motif + BrandDNA into a DesignCompositionSpec JSON with full explainability
guarantees: Pure deterministic computation — same input always produces same compositionId

routesToMount.note: All routes except /ai/composer/health are covered by global adminAuth middleware in app.ts. No per-route auth setup required.

integrationNotes: Engine is pure computation — no DB tables, no migrations, no schema barrel changes required.
All admin routes are covered by global adminAuth middleware in app.ts.
No external HTTP calls — zero SSRF surface.
compositionId is SHA-256 of normalised input — safe to cache by ID indefinitely.
Zod schemas live entirely in the service layer; route file imports only from service index, never zod/v4 directly.

KNOWN LIMITATION — IN-MEMORY SESSION STORE: compositionSessionStore is an in-process Map (not a DB table, Redis, or any external store). All session state is lost when the API server process restarts, is redeployed, or is scaled to multiple instances. Callers must re-submit composition requests after a restart; they cannot rely on a previously returned compositionId surviving across server restarts. This is intentional — the engine is pure deterministic computation and sessions are cheap to recreate. If persistence across restarts is required in future, Team 24 must provision a Redis/DB-backed store and update the CompositionSessionStore interface accordingly.
Cross-tenant IDOR: session lookup key = SHA-256(tenantId NUL idempotencyKey) — different tenants never collide.

knownLimitations.title: In-memory compositionSessionStore — sessions lost on restart
knownLimitations.description: compositionSessionStore is a Node.js in-process Map. No external store, no DB table, no Redis. Sessions do not survive server restarts, deployments, or horizontal scaling (multiple instances would have independent stores).
knownLimitations.impact: Callers that hold a compositionId from a previous server instance will receive 404 on GET /session/:key after a restart. Idempotency keys are invalidated. No data loss (sessions contain only computation specs, no persistent user data).
knownLimitations.workaround: Callers should handle 404 on session lookup by re-submitting the composition request with the same inputs — compositionId is deterministic (SHA-256 of inputs), so the result will be identical.
knownLimitations.futureResolution: If persistence is required: implement a Redis- or DB-backed adapter behind the CompositionSessionStore interface and inject it at startup. The interface boundary is already defined — no service logic changes needed.

terminalStateRules.completed: Return existing DesignCompositionSpec. Never reprocess. Response includes idempotent:true.
terminalStateRules.failed: Block unless allowRetry=true is set explicitly in the request. Retry transitions failed → pending.
terminalStateRules.cancelled: Always blocked. Caller must create a new request with a different idempotencyKey.
terminalStateRules.processing: Block with 409 IN_PROGRESS. Concurrent execution guard.

endpoints.description: Compose a full DesignCompositionSpec. Supports idempotency via idempotencyKey+tenantId.
endpoints.tenantScoping: tenantId in body (required when idempotencyKey provided). X-Tenant-Id header takes priority.

endpoints.description: Validate inputs and preview fallbacks without composing
Check cross-element compatibility (material, pattern, palette, decoration)
Get session by idempotency key. IDOR-protected: scoped strictly to X-Tenant-Id header.
endpoints.tenantScoping: X-Tenant-Id header required. Cross-tenant lookups return 404.

scenarios: no-asset fallback (all inputs missing → defaults applied)
brand-DNA-derived fallbacks (colors, typography, layout from brand DNA)
brand consistency alignment (color, typography, layout, personality)
state machine: all valid transitions allowed
state machine: completed/cancelled have no outgoing transitions
IDOR: tenant A cannot read tenant B session (404)
IDOR: X-Tenant-Id header takes priority over body tenantId
idempotency: same key+tenant → existing session returned
boundary: Team 13 accepts LayoutPlanInput verbatim from Team 12
boundary: all 10 layout strategies pass through unchanged
boundary: no layout solver functions exported from public API
